stackDivergence.rationale: Task124 removes the temporary TextItem FontWeight and FontItalic const/type compatibility bridges. TextItem and all existing Writer defaults, attributes, text hints, numbering fonts, ODT import and paragraph painting consumers use the single original tools enums and native WEIGHT_/ITALIC_ member names directly. Literal numeric values, Svx item behavior and existing document contracts are unchanged. Only two obsolete bridge-consistency assertions are removed; native value, conversion and Writer behavioral assertions remain. This supersedes earlier task122/123 alias notes without rewriting history. The user explicitly authorizes canonical shared and Writer corrections without compatibility workarounds. Existing semantic states, provenance classifications, mapped/local-only status and conscious save/open/recovery deviations remain unchanged; this owner/import cleanup is not broad native parity certification. Complete document/UI and same-model ODS load/save remain pending. Whole Calc and complete changed shared owners require raw S/B/F/L100; Writer-only coverage gaps remain exempt by user instruction. No full regression until minimum actual UI+ODS readiness, then relevant repairs and goal pause.
